column2: [intro]
When coffee's making everyone around buzz,
I don't care, I prefer my tea just because.
People drink it black, I like it green,
A simple infusion, that’s all I need, serene.
Tea's not funky, it's not rock,
But it's good, it flows, and it truly unlocks.
Tea, so gentle in a porcelain cup,
It's my ally, my little bit of luck.
In the morning, when all is still asleep,
I savor my tea, calm and deep.
Others add sugar, milk, and tales,
I prefer it pure, without grand details.
Tea's not funky, it's not rock,
But it's good, it flows, and it truly unlocks.
Tea, so gentle in a porcelain cup,
It's my ally, my little bit of luck.
